🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
RISK-ON. Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: strong sector breadth plus cyclicals/financials leadership (Financials and Industrials showing ABOVE TREND); Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Top performers are Technology).

2. Which sectors are leading?
Materials lead: CRH (1W: +12.67% | 1M: +13.36%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +10.46% | 1M: +10.17%) ABOVE TREND. Industrials strong: ETN (1W: +11.60% | 1M: +13.27%) ABOVE TREND, CAT (1W: +10.24% | 1M: +11.74%) ABOVE TREND. Financials rising: JPM (1W: +5.72% | 1M: +8.32%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Energy weak: XOM (1W: -5.09% | 1M: +0.61%) CORRECTION, CVX (1W: -5.24% | 1M: -1.69%) BELOW TREND. Communication under pressure: (sector 1W: -0.86%). Technology showing mixed internals despite top performers (sector 1W: +1.69%).

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: INTC (1W: +23.82% | 1M: +30.01%) ABOVE TREND; LRCX (1W: +20.70% | 1M: +20.46%) ABOVE TREND; AVGO (1W: +18.12% | 1M: +9.01%) ABOVE TREND; AMAT (1W: +14.64% | 1M: +13.79%) ABOVE TREND; AMZN (1W: +13.64% | 1M: +12.10%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: IBM (1W: -7.01% | 1M: -7.28%) BELOW TREND; ADBE (1W: -7.23% | 1M: -17.67%) BELOW TREND; MPC (1W: -7.91% | 1M: -1.82%) BELOW TREND; OXY (1W: -7.94% | 1M: +4.30%) CORRECTION; PSX (1W: -9.62% | 1M: -6.05%) BELOW TREND.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Top 1W momentum: INTC (1W: +23.82% | 1M: +30.01%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +20.70% | 1M: +20.46%) ABOVE TREND, AVGO (1W: +18.12% | 1M: +9.01%) ABOVE TREND. Major divergence noted (AAPL, META, V, MA, LLY, HD with 1W vs 1M mismatches) — MAJOR DIVERGENCE, watch for trend break and treat fresh strength as tactical, not automatic core allocation.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed but constructive: INTC (1W: +23.82% | 1M: +30.01%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +6.34% | 1M: +1.40%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +12.66% | 1M: +19.63%) ABOVE TREND; offset by sizeable losers like NOW (1W: -18.63% | 1M: -28.22%) BELOW TREND and ADBE (1W: -7.23% | 1M: -17.67%) BELOW TREND. Sector internals mixed; watch narrow leadership risk.

8. Financials Outlook?
Healthy and broad: JPM (1W: +5.72% | 1M: +8.32%) ABOVE TREND with multiple banks and financials participating; V (1W: +1.18% | 1M: -1.49%) RECOVERY and MA (1W: +1.23% | 1M: -0.89%) RECOVERY show short-term rotation into payments. Sector breadth supportive of the RISK-ON backdrop.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Mixed defensives and idiosyncratic moves: UNH (1W: +9.76% | 1M: +6.69%) ABOVE TREND confirming headline-driven strength; JNJ (1W: -1.88% | 1M: -1.86%) BELOW TREND and PFE (1W: -4.94% | 1M: -1.39%) BELOW TREND show uneven internals. Several biopharma names (LLY (1W: +0.42% | 1M: -6.04%) RECOVERY) have headline-driven flows.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor cyclicals/value-tilt within RISK-ON: emphasize JPM (1W: +5.72% | 1M: +8.32%) ABOVE TREND, CAT (1W: +10.24% | 1M: +11.74%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +10.46% | 1M: +10.17%) ABOVE TREND; reduce exposure to structurally weak names showing sustained BELOW TREND behavior like NOW (1W: -18.63% | 1M: -28.22%) BELOW TREND and ADBE (1W: -7.23% | 1M: -17.67%) BELOW TREND. Style: Value/Cyclical tilt.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: INTC (1W: +23.82% | 1M: +30.01%) ABOVE TREND — momentum follow-through; AMZN (1W: +13.64% | 1M: +12.10%) ABOVE TREND — earnings/operational catalyst watch; UNH (1W: +9.76% | 1M: +6.69%) ABOVE TREND — Medicare rate lift confirmed. BEARISH: NOW (1W: -18.63% | 1M: -28.22%) BELOW TREND — headlines pressuring shares; PSX (1W: -9.62% | 1M: -6.05%) BELOW TREND — derivatives loss headline.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Materials (1W: +4.82% | 1M: +6.76%) and Industrials (1W: +4.13% | 1M: +0.45%) — strong internals. BEARISH: Energy (1W: -4.25% | 1M: +1.25%) — mixed headlines and pullbacks may extend.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch continuation signals and reversals: INTC sustained follow-through above the prior weekly high would confirm ABOVE TREND momentum (1W: +23.82% | 1M: +30.01%) ABOVE TREND; AMZN holding recent breakout is necessary to keep ABOVE TREND momentum (1W: +13.64% | 1M: +12.10%) ABOVE TREND; NVDA retest of short-term support will indicate tech internals (1W: +6.34% | 1M: +1.40%) ABOVE TREND.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
XOM (+60): Huge Guyana find headline; XOM (1W: -5.09% | 1M: +0.61%) CORRECTION — sentiment positive but price pulled back, watch for re-accumulation. UNH (+60): Medicare rate lift; UNH (1W: +9.76% | 1M: +6.69%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed. LLY (+55): GLP-1 pill launch; LLY (1W: +0.42% | 1M: -6.04%) RECOVERY — news aligns with short-term bounce. AMZN (+50): CEO comments; AMZN (1W: +13.64% | 1M: +12.10%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirming price. MPC (+55): upgraded outlook/buybacks; MPC (1W: -7.91% | 1M: -1.82%) BELOW TREND — sentiment divergent vs recent price weakness.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
PSX (-60): Derivatives loss headline; PSX (1W: -9.62% | 1M: -6.05%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed. NOW (-50): downgrade scrutiny of AI strategy; NOW (1W: -18.63% | 1M: -28.22%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed and price under pressure. ORCL (-45): CFO compensation/layoff headlines; ORCL in negative news — monitor relative weakness against peers.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON, Value/Cyclical style given broad sector participation and cyclicals/financials strength. INTC (1W: +23.82% | 1M: +30.01%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +20.70% | 1M: +20.46%) ABOVE TREND and AMZN (1W: +13.64% | 1M: +12.10%) ABOVE TREND are showing clear relative strength. Key risk: MAJOR DIVERGENCE among several large-cap names (AAPL, META, V, MA, LLY, HD), and a handful of headline-driven names (PSX, NOW, MPC) warrant monitoring despite the RISK-ON backdrop.
